algorithm.title: Breast Mass in Women Younger than 30 Years: Diagnosis.

cell.label: Breast mass in a woman younger than 30 years, with high clinical suspicion, or with low clinical suspicion but the mass persists over 1 to 2 menstrual cycles.
BI-RADS category and clinical suspicion?
cell.path: BI-RADS 3 and high clinical suspicion, or BI-RADS 4

cell.label: Observation; biopsy if the mass increases in size.
Assess stability with ultrasound or mammography at 6 to 12 months, for 1 to 2 years.

footnotes.footnote: BI-RADS, American College of Radiology Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System.

algorithm.title: Breast Mass in Women 30 Years or Older: Diagnosis.

cell.label: Breast mass in a woman 30 years or older.
Mammography.
cell.path: BI-RADS 4 or 5, or BI-RADS 3 and clinically suspicious

cell.label: Observation with or without imaging; biopsy if the mass increases in size.
Observation; biopsy if the mass increases in size.

footnotes.footnote: For women 30 to 39 years, ultrasound, mammography, or digital breast tomosynthesis are all appropriate as the first test (American College of Radiology, 2022).
BI-RADS, American College of Radiology Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System.
